description: Framework overlay rules for fabriq. Consumed by dev/build_framework_patch.ps1 (patch builder) and by external update tools (fabriq_studio) to decide which files are 'framework' (overlayable) and which are 'site-specific' (must be preserved on the target).

kernel.description: Top-level framework bundle. Versioned by kernel/KERNEL_VERSION. Includes the kernel library, apps, commands, dev tooling, and top-level framework files (README.md, CHANGELOG.md, CLAUDE.md, LICENSE, Fabriq.exe, Deploy.bat). When an update tool detects a kernel version mismatch, every file under these paths (minus the site-specific exclusions above) is overlaid as one unit.

module.description: Per-module bundle. Each module at modules/<type>/<name>/ is its own versioning unit. Versioned by modules/<type>/<name>/VERSION. An update tool compares VERSION between template and target per module; if template > target, that entire module directory is overlaid EXCEPT any CSV not in moduleCsvWhitelist (which represents the site-specific _list.csv family and must be preserved).

notes.profilesPreservation: All files under profiles/ are ALWAYS preserved on the target, even if the template ships newer versions. This is a deliberate policy: profile CSVs may have been customized per site, and format changes (if any) are handled via manual migration, never automatic overwrite.
notes.missingVersionFile: A module may lack a VERSION file (pre-VERSION legacy modules). Treat it as 'unknown version' - an update tool should consider the template side as newer if the template has a VERSION file and the target does not.
notes.requiresKernelCheck: Before overlaying a module bundle, compare the template module's REQUIRES_KERNEL against the target's kernel/KERNEL_VERSION. If REQUIRES_KERNEL > target kernel version, the kernel bundle must be overlaid first (or the module update blocked).
notes.newModulesFromTemplate: If the template has a module directory that the target does not, overlay copies module.csv / preset.csv / all scripts / Guide.txt / VERSION / REQUIRES_KERNEL. Site-specific CSVs (e.g. _list.csv) are NOT copied - the operator must create them via Fabriq Studio based on the module's Guide.txt.
notes.existingModulesAbsentFromTemplate: If the target has a module the template does not, it is treated as a site-custom module and preserved untouched.
